title: Montmartre Stained Glass
description: A vibrant stained glass style painting depicts a sunny Parisian street scene in Montmartre. A couple with a blue umbrella walks along a colorful cobblestone path lined with shops including a Home Depot store, flower pots, and green shutters, with Sacré-Cœur Basilica visible on the hill under a bright sun.
prompt: Vibrant stained glass artwork of a sunny day in Montmartre Paris, a couple holding a blue umbrella walking on colorful cobblestone street lined with shops and flower pots, one shop sign reads HOME DEPOT, green shutters and orange awnings on buildings, Sacré-Cœur Basilica on the hill in the background, large bright sun in the sky, trees with yellow leaves, rich colors and bold black leading lines typical of stained glass
